payload.rationale: Brief sets journey_stage 'planning' and the goal as a conversation with a Wedded Advisor via /wonderland-concierge, which services.md lists as the Wedded Concierge page. The copy already carries the CTAs and they are recorded as written: secondary after the themes (line 139), primary after the destination venue questions (line 156), a magnet link to /magazine in 'Planning your table settings' (line 180) for the earlier-stage reader, and a closing Concierge link under 'Plan your reception with a Wedded Advisor' (line 210). All use anchor 'Wedded Concierge' and the agreed UTMs. Panel cta_reactions: funding_parent and uhnw 'maybe', planner_couple, sceptic and search_visitor 'no', mostly 'bookmark, not enquire' because table settings come later in planning. The primary sits after the 'in writing' advice and the hire-in cost question the panel asked for, so what readers wanted to see first already comes before it. Lead magnet suggestion: a booking checklist of place setting pieces and venue questions would suit the bookmarking reader, but it has no page on the site, so exists is false and it is not placed.
